svg.title: AI Coding Tools in 2026: A Developer’s Guide to Productivity and Quality
svg.desc: This guide explores the best AI coding tools available in 2026, focusing on how developers can choose the right tool for their team and workflow. It addresses trade-offs, security considerations, and productivity impacts, with a critical assessment of reported gains and potential pitfalls.
